_meta.setup: Isolated `opencode serve` (separate XDG config, data, state and cache directories, minimal environment). The claude-agent integration was connected through its external `claude-login` method, which stores only the method reference and no token. Plugins in order: a scratch recorder, then runtime/adapters/opencode_plugin.ts with its python option set to a missing interpreter, so the routing child could never start (child down).
_meta.sanitizer: Payloads are the recorder's sanitized copies of the raw hook events, with every top-level key kept. IDs are placeholders (<ses#n>, <msg#n>, <toolu#n>), numbers are <number>, other strings are <string> except agent, kind, tool, action, effect, type, model id, provider, variant and a subagent's provider/model#variant. Header and environment maps are reduced to their name count; their names and values were not recorded. Each session's IDs are numbered from 1 within that session's capture.

observations.result: HTTP 500 rpc.internal 'RPC call failed'; a launcher treats any non-ok answer as refuse

observations.case: attach through a symlinked spelling of the project directory instead of its canonical path
observations.result: a second plugin instance was set up; the session's own instance never saw the attach and its shell kept the dummy credential. Attach and health must use the session's canonical directory

observations.case: shell.create.before through session.shell while a session was attached in the canonical instance
observations.result: a dummy S33_PROBE_TOKEN in the server environment read 'absent' in the shell; after detach it was present again. No model call

observations.case: subagent spawn after attach, child down
observations.result: tool part status=error 'routing: blocked (routing_unavailable)'; no child session was created

observations.case: follow-up model.request of an attached session, child down
observations.result: idle outcome=failed 'routing: blocked (routing_unavailable)'; no assistant message, no tokens

observations.case: model.request of a child session created with parentID of an attached session
observations.result: blocked through ctx.session.get parentID lineage; idle outcome=failed, no assistant message, no tokens

observations.case: webfetch in a session attached during permission.evaluate
observations.result: tool part error type=permission.rejected with the shim's deny message; in the second run a local listener on the target URL recorded 0 hits

model_calls.sent_detail: Each was the first primary request of a session that was not yet attached (interactive), so the shim let it through; the session was attached afterwards at its subagent spawn or webfetch permission.
